in_marathi.name: Nandika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nandika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'nandana', meaning 'giver of joy' or 'delight'. In Hindu mythology, Nandi is the name of Lord Shiva's vehicle, a bull who is believed to embody the qualities of joy and happiness. The name is often given to girls in the hope that they will bring joy and delight to their families.
